verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs describe agents (Claude Code/Codex) running directly 'on your own machine' in a checkout of the repository, with Foreloop only approving tasks and tracking status — there is no mention of an isolated sandbox, container, or safe execution environment for running code or installing dependencies. The architecture as documented actually runs agents locally rather than in isolation, and no sandboxing capability is claimed or evidenced anywhere in the pack.
